notes.title: 12/15 Patch notes
notes.notes:
Characters
[olist]
 Caerywn

 Shared Burden has been reworked:
Now Transfers Health from the highest % Health ally to the lowest % Health ally.
Generates Commanding Aura when health is transferred from the Knight.
 Ultimate augments can increase the number of transfers per 3s, or reduce the transfer damage and increase Commanding Aura generation when empowered.

 Khy

 Arcane Familiar and Arcane shield damage buffed by 100%. They should now be competitive with Firebolt for damage per Global.
 Quality of Life: Arcane Familiar buff indicators now always show their maximum duration. You can refresh without any loss when the duration is less than half.
 Firebolt cast time increased to 3s (from 2.5s). Damage increased to compensate.
 Fire Wave cast time reduced to 1.5s (from 3s). This should make Khy's combo feel more responsive.

 Kissa

 Pyrl's Mark and Aphasia's Mercy now deal 1 tick of damage or healing instantly, and have a maximum duration of 24s (up from 22s).
 Quality of Life: Pyrl's Mark and Aphasia's Mercy buff indicators now always show their maximum duration. You can refresh without any loss when the duration is less than half.
 Skomorok's Wrath cast time increased to 3s (from 1.5s). Numbers adjusted to compensate. Note: Kissa has a lot of casts per minute due to buff management. This change should give her a bit of down time when building Blessings.
 Lugubri's Cloud duration increased to 1.5s per Blessing consumed (from 1s), but damage per second reduced to compensate.

 Krug

 Pack Mentality and Thick Skin removed from the GCD.
 Thick Skin now grants an absorb shield in addition to the damage reduction.
 Pack Mentality duration increased to 12s (from 8s) and Attack Speed / Cooldown Reduction increased to 60% (from 40%). Now also grants 1 stack of Dingo Stance on use.

 Talon

 Talon is perfect just the way he is! <3

[/olist]
